text:
alex: Heads-up 10: connector API office hours this Fri 2pm PT. Focus: adapter contract for tooling partners (LangChain / LlamaIndex / gateway adapters). Need to lock auth flow, manifest fields, and versioning policy. Pls RSVP.

maria: I can make it. Can we include a 10-min demo of the smoke-test harness?

sam: Agree. Quick question: upstream LangChain adapters currently use `model_alias`. Should we keep that or switch to `model_family`? If we change, adapters will need a shim.

lina: From SI side: add rollout & rollback cadence. Proposed: 2-week canary, health probe, and auto-fallback to previous manifest on failure. We'll bring runbook snippets.

devon: Partner Eng will demo a minimal harness (helm + docker-compose) and a tiny adapter shim. Local quickstart snippet:

```
# local harness dev
git clone git@internal.redwood:partners/connector-harness.git
cd connector-harness
./scripts/run-local.sh --with-adapter-shim
```

We recommend mock cloud creds for demos.

jonathan: Also important: standardize OpenTelemetry span tags (service.name, rw.connector.id, rw.request.id, gateway.adapter.name). SIs can correlate gateway <-> Redwood traces with this. I'll post a suggested tag list.

alex: Agenda updated: 1) spec review 2) alias vs family mapping 3) canary & rollback 4) harness demo & creds 5) tracing contract 6) marketplace packaging checklist and announcement timing.

maria: Who should I invite from LangChain / LlamaIndex? I can DM their SDK leads if we have names.

sam: CC @jess-langchain and @rob-lindex 10 - they'll join. I'll ping them.

devon: Action items before Fri: 1) I'll open PR for harness + README (ETA Thu EOD). 2) Sam, can you draft compatibility matrix mapping `model_alias` -> `model_family` with migration notes? 3) Maria, send invites to external SDK contacts.

lina: SI will prep rollback runbook + infra/security checklist for marketplace packaging.

alex: Meeting link: https://meet.internal.redwood/rooms/connector-office-hours. If you can't make Fri 2pm PT drop availability.

partner-bot: Reminder created: "Connector adapter contract office hours" Fri 14:00 PT (organizer: alex).

maria: One more ask: can we pre-seed a small regression prompt set for the harness so we can catch obvious model/adapter regressions? Research can add it.

sam: Send me the prompts, I'll wire them into the smoke tests to fail CI on major regressions.

alex: Thanks all 10. See you Friday.
